scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n docker,web -c yellow,blue "docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up --build" "pnpm --filter quickjob-frontend dev"
scripts.dev:api: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build postgres api celery
scripts.api:migrate: docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head

scripts.api:migrate:current: docker compose exec api alembic current
